tips: The 4 steps show where you are.
Unbilled trips are waiting to be invoiced.
Switch company from the top menu.
Pick a car or add a new one from the list.
Closing km must be more than opening km.
Use "Save & add another" for many trips.
Your entries save automatically as you type.
Only local and outstation trips can be entered here.
Use "Log trip" for a named or fixed package.
One trip = one duty slip.
Duty date decides which month it's billed in.
Toll, tax and parking are added on the invoice.
Billed trips are locked.
Invoices are built from trips.
Invoice date is printed on the bill; billing period picks the trips.
Add toll, state tax and parking as an extra charge.
Check the preview before issuing.
Quick invoice logs one trip and issues its invoice in one step.
Use Build invoice instead when billing several trips together.
⋮ menu has Download, Share, Edit, Mark paid, Undo.
Paid and undone invoices can't be edited.
Share sends the PDF straight from your device.
Vehicles used in trips can't be deleted — mark them inactive instead.
You can add a vehicle right from the trip form too.
State decides CGST+SGST or IGST.
Tick RCM only if the client pays GST themselves.
You can add a client right from the trip form too.
One rate card per client per car type.
Changing rates never changes issued invoices — but it does affect any invoice you build afterward, even for older trips.
Download the template first.
Don't rename the column headings.
Only .xlsx, up to 10 MB.
Company state decides GST.
Branding controls how your logo appears on invoices.
Next invoice number continues your old numbering.
Accepting a quotation saves its rates as a rate card.
A quotation can be edited at any time, even after it's accepted.
